summary: Refund timeline under Delhi Value Added Tax Act, 2004 s.38(3) mandatory; department cannot adjust refund beyond stipulated two-month period after quarterly return submission; default notices issued after expiry of refund processing timeline therefore unenforceable for adjustment; department must adhere to statutory timeline before exercising adjustment power under s.38(2); Flipkart India precedent affirmed.
legal_provisions_cited: Delhi Value Added Tax Act, 2004 s.38(3)
Delhi Value Added Tax Act, 2004 s.38(2)
Delhi Value Added Tax Act, 2004 s.38(1)
Delhi Value Added Tax Act, 2004 s.59
Delhi Value Added Tax Act, 2004 s.58
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court judgment quashing adjustment order upheld; refund with interest directed as per s.42.
